import sys

def get(w, m):
    stack = [m]
    while stack:
        x = stack.pop()
        if x == 0:
            return True
        if x % w != 0:
            continue
        x //= w
        if x == 1:
            return True
        stack.append(x + 1)
        stack.append(x - 1)
        stack.append(x)
    return False

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    ans = get(w, m) or get(w, m - 1) or get(w, m + 1)
    print("YES" if ans else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
